name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.25: serve paymentSerialPort in the fridge config block so the Nayax port survives a reinstall. Setting it by command lived in app state, and machine 8626020716 has Device Owner cleared, so a reinstall would have silently reverted it to the wrong port and lost three days of diagnosis. Config now carries it, defaulting to /dev/ttyS1 for gravity machines, and it is settable through the machine settings endpoint with the same bus-collision guard as the command. Recorded in the source where it matters: the serial assignment is exactly swapped between machine types — coil uses ttyS3 for Nayax and ttyS1 for motors, gravity uses ttyS3 for the weight bus and ttyS1 for Nayax — neither can be inferred from the other, and assuming they matched is what cost the three days. Cumulative over v6.24.
